scope: Validity of the thinking-contract accuracy arms on the llama.cpp serving path. This record exists because the first thinking arm produced the best MMLU-Pro score of any arm and would have been reported as a win; it is truncation-limited and the comparison is not valid.

finding.summary: Both thinking-contract arms were run at max_tokens=2048. 13.0% of MMLU-Pro items and 6.0% of GSM8K items hit finish_reason=length. The chat arms truncated at 5.5% and 1.0% under their own budgets, so the arms are not comparable on truncation exposure and the thinking scores are floors, not estimates.
finding.why_it_was_not_obvious: The token distribution is bimodal. Median completion length is 191 tokens on MMLU-Pro thinking -- lower than the 768-token chat budget -- so a median-based budget check passes cleanly. The p90 sits exactly ON the 2048 ceiling, which is the signature of a censored distribution: the true tail length is not observable from this run at all. Only that at least 13% of items exceed 2048.

measured.note: completion_tokens from each transcript's response.usage; percentiles over all items in the arm

interpretation.mmlu_pro: 203/253 at 2048 already beats the pre-0731 baseline of 197/253, and it does so while losing 32 items to the ceiling. The direction of the effect is therefore not in doubt -- clearing truncation can only raise it -- but the magnitude is unmeasured and 203 must not be quoted as the thinking-contract score.
interpretation.gsm8k: 94/100 at 2048 is BELOW both the 97/100 chat arm and the 97/100 baseline, and 4 items were lost to the ceiling. The apparent 3-point regression from enabling thinking is fully accounted for by truncation and is not evidence that thinking hurts GSM8K.
interpretation.what_would_have_been_wrong: Reporting 'thinking wins MMLU-Pro 203/253 and loses GSM8K 94/100' would have been two false conclusions from one budget artifact.

action.taken: Both thinking arms are being re-run at max_tokens=8192. A partial re-run of only the truncated items was rejected: mixing budgets inside one arm makes the arm uncomparable to anything, including itself.
action.acceptance: The re-run is valid only if its truncated_fraction is at or below the corresponding chat arm's (0.055 for MMLU-Pro, 0.010 for GSM8K). If 8192 does not clear it, the budget is raised again rather than the result being reported.

relation_to_review: This is the concrete instance of the xhigh reviewer's finding 9 requirement -- preregistered ceilings on invalid/truncated items, applied to both arms so a broken baseline cannot lower the bar -- and of Track B2 in the plan. The ceiling is set here from the chat arms' measured rates rather than chosen after seeing the thinking results.
